data.text: A specific mutation called c.3791G>A (p.R1264H) in the RTEL1 gene was found at a carrier frequency of 1% in the Ashkenazi Orthodox population and 0.45% in the general Ashkenazi Jewish population [6].
I found 5 published papers on this topic [1][2][3][4][5].
This is a research summary, not medical advice.

data.claim_text: Our screening showed that the carrier frequency for c.3791G>A (p.R1264H) was higher than expected, 1% in the Ashkenazi Orthodox and 0.45% in the general Ashkenazi Jewish population.
